title: vSkinSwap
description: vSkinSwap lets players change their skin using a player name, image link, or reset command. Supports Paper/Folia, configurable messages, permissions, reload, and saved skins after rejoin.
body:
[![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef01ad6b39a79dd292c4984e6b8a8c27b08d08c9.png)](https://discord.gg/5AWcWHBCPt)

vSkinSwap is a lightweight and easy-to-use skin-changing plugin for Paper and Folia servers.  
It allows players to change their Minecraft skin directly in-game using simple commands.

## Features

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Player skin support | Use the skin of any Minecraft username, including offline players. |
| Image link support | Apply a skin using a direct image link. |![SkinSwap](https://s5.ezgif.com/tmp/ezgif-518e3bf5e1d0059f.gif)
| Reset command | Restore your own original Minecraft skin. |
| Rejoin saving | The last selected skin stays saved after rejoining. |
| Configurable messages | Every message can be edited in the config. |
| MiniMessage support | Messages support modern MiniMessage formatting. |
| Custom permissions | Each command action has its own permission. |
| Reload command | Reload the config without restarting the server. |
| Paper & Folia support | Built for modern Paper and Folia servers. |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/vskin <player>` | Changes your skin to the skin of a Minecraft player. |
| `/vskin <link>` | Changes your skin using a direct image link. |
| `/vskin me` | Resets your skin back to your own original skin. |
| `/vskin reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration. |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `vskinswap.use.player` | Allows using player name skins. |
| `vskinswap.use.link` | Allows using skin image links. |
| `vskinswap.use.me` | Allows resetting to your own skin. |
| `vskinswap.reload` | Allows reloading the plugin config. |

## Configuration

vSkinSwap includes a fully editable `config.yml`.  
Server owners can customize the plugin prefix, all messages, permissions, and general settings.

All messages support MiniMessage, so you can easily style the plugin to match your server.

![SkinSwap](https://s5.ezgif.com/tmp/ezgif-518e3bf5e1d0059f.gif)
